abstract_sentences.text: Dense retrievers play a vital role in accessing external and specialized knowledge to augment language models (LMs).

evidence.anchor: Dense retrievers play a vital role

abstract_sentences.text: Training dense retrievers typically requires annotated query-document pairs, which are costly to create and scarce in specialized domains (e.g., code) or in complex settings (e.g., requiring reasoning).

evidence.anchor: annotated query-document pairs … costly … scarce

abstract_sentences.text: These practical challenges have sparked growing interest in self-supervised retriever learning.

evidence.anchor: growing interest in self-supervised retriever learning

abstract_sentences.text: Since LMs are trained to capture token-level dependencies through a self-supervised learning objective (i.e., next token prediction), we can analogously cast retrieval as learning dependencies among chunks of tokens.

evidence.anchor: learning dependencies among chunks of tokens

abstract_sentences.text: This analogy naturally leads to the question: How can we adapt self-supervised learning objectives in the spirit of language modeling to train retrievers?

evidence.anchor: How can we adapt self-supervised learning objectives

abstract_sentences.text: To answer this question, we introduce Revela, a unified and scalable training framework for self-supervised retriever learning via language modeling.

evidence.anchor: we introduce Revela, a unified and scalable training framework

abstract_sentences.text: Revela models semantic dependencies among documents by conditioning next token prediction on local and cross-document context through an in-batch attention mechanism.

evidence.anchor: local and cross-document context

abstract_sentences.text: This attention is weighted by retriever-computed similarity scores, enabling the retriever to be optimized as part of language modeling.

evidence.anchor: weighted by retriever-computed similarity scores

abstract_sentences.text: We evaluate Revela on domain-specific (CoIR), reasoning-intensive (BRIGHT), and general-domain (BEIR) benchmarks across various retriever backbones.

evidence.anchor: CoIR … BRIGHT … BEIR

abstract_sentences.text: Without annotated or synthetic query-document pairs, Revela surpasses larger supervised models and proprietary APIs on both CoIR and BRIGHT.

evidence.anchor: surpasses larger supervised models and proprietary APIs

abstract_sentences.text: It achieves BEIR’s unsupervised SoTA with ~1000x less training data and 10x less compute.

evidence.anchor: ~ 1000x less training data and 10x less compute

abstract_sentences.text: Performance increases with batch size and model size, highlighting Revela’s scalability and its promise for self-supervised retriever learning.

evidence.anchor: Performance increases with batch size and model size

final_judgment.single_storyline: 以 document-level retriever similarity 作为 cross-document in-batch attention 权重，使 NTP 在 raw-text chunks 上联合训练 retriever 与 LM，从而替代 query-document pair supervision（p.2 §1；p.4–5 §3；p.10 §7）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq.(1)–(7)、Fig.1/2、CoIR Table 1、BRIGHT/BEIR Fig.3、核心数据和预算，以及 Contriever/batch/LM-size 诊断，足以判断 task-mean 机制与效能（p.4–9）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 逐任务结果、checkpoint/license、chunk 示例、REPLUG/Contriever 实现、V-normalization、mixed/out-of-domain、LM 保真度和复杂度移入 p.15–24；均值决策可由正文读取，但 heterogeneity、variant dependency、复现入口和 efficiency 细节依赖附录（p.15–24）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Fig.1/2 先画出 similarity → attention → NTP → backprop 数据流，再用 Table 1/Fig.3 以同一 nDCG@10 量尺放入弱监督、监督、API 与 compute context，形成机制到决策的短链（p.2、p.4、p.7）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: higher mean、scaling 和 efficiency 被组合成较宽 capability 叙事，但没有 run variance、显著性、实测 efficiency 或统一 V-normalization 控制；BEIR 45.2 与 45.6 是近似而非严格胜出，逐任务有例外（p.7–9、p.19–24）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 新训练信号论文应先用机制图固定梯度/数据流，再用主表固定分母、比较对象和资源条件；逐任务、方差与实现 variant 放入可引用附录，并在正文标明依赖关系（p.2、p.7、p.19–24）。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于新训练信号与多 benchmark/baseline 的 retrieval/LM 论文；稳定性、效率保证、因果机制或跨模态主张仍需 seed-level uncertainty、matched resource test、component ablation 或目标模态实验（p.7–10、p.23–24）。
